sample_scopes.detail: di-glycine remnant profiling (K-GG) from HEK293 cells

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The in vitro samples were acquired using data-dependent acquisition (DDA) on a Lumos Tribrid and analyzed with MaxQuant using label-free quantification (LFQ) principles (Andromeda scores, intensities).
The cellular ubiquitinomics samples were acquired in data-independent acquisition (DIA) mode on an Orbitrap Astral and processed with DIA-NN.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: Explicit use of K-GG (diGly) remnant profiling for both in vitro and cellular samples, including the use of PTMScan HS K-ε-GG Remnant Magnetic Immunoaffinity Beads.
